description: This file defines a controller class for handling FAQ-related web requests in a Catalyst-based web application. It includes an 'index' action that retrieves FAQ entries from the database, manages access control, and prepares data for rendering.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::FAQ
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class for FAQ pages, extending Coocook::Controller.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests for the FAQ page, retrieves FAQ data, checks permissions, and sets up data for the view.
